_comment: Cells that answer whoever stops on them (Managers/FloorRiddles.cs).
spots: a cell with PuzzleCase cases (criterion, needs/lacks marks, message, gives, takes, mark, unmark, for, toMap, toCell).
riddles: numbered floor tiles, one step per island; the right digit of a step sends the character to that
step's toCell, any other plays «wrong». The digits come from the document the readable gave the character

spots.why: Quest 1934, the cell: «Allez dans le coin en bas à gauche de la carte, au-dessus de la bouche d'aération» (Dofus pour les noobs, «La bande des Toxines»); message 863 «Encuentras una vieja llave maestra escondida bajo la rejilla de ventilación». Cell 353 is the floor's left corner on the lower-left edge, INFERRED; not while the guardian watches.

Quest 1934, the islets: the skull tile (gfx 57819) on the last islet «returns you to the other side» (Dofus pour les noobs, «La bande des Toxines»): back to the first islet by the door to the three-door room. Landing cell 547 INFERRED.

riddles.why: Quest 1934: «marchez sur les dalles dans l'ordre de la solution» (Dofus pour les noobs, «La bande des Toxines»); the riddle the scrolls give is «différente d'une personnage à l'autre, il en existe un total de 24», documents 519-542, each solved by three digits (the guide's table). The digit tiles are the client's sprites 13532/13534/13535/13538 (2/4/5/8) on each islet; the islets in order: the door's (lower left), upper left, lower right, then the islet of the last door. Landing cells (268, 530, 235) are INFERRED: walkable cells of the next islet off its tiles. A wrong tile is message 860, back to the cell.
